title: Evaluating Evaluation Metrics: A Framework for Analyzing NLG Evaluation Metrics using Measurement Theory
reasoning: The paper discusses 'downstream harms to individuals and society' and 'defining and evaluating fair natural language generation' in the context of the implications of problematic evaluation metrics. However, its core framework (METRICEVAL) focuses on the reliability and validity of evaluation metrics using measurement theory, rather than proposing or applying methods to explicitly evaluate or benchmark specific religious, moral, or ethical dimensions of NLG outputs or models.
